note: Bump `commit` to sync the bundled .cwl command library with upstream, and update `expectFiles` to the new count (`git ls-tree -r --name-only <commit> -- completion | grep -c '\.cwl$'`). Pinning keeps builds reproducible: the same Clavis tag always ships the same command set. `expectFiles` is a tripwire — the fetch fails loudly rather than silently shipping a partial library.
